automation_name: AI Security Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.date_policy: Only records with an explicit publication timestamp strictly after the cutoff and no later than the run time qualify. Date-only, ambiguous, future-dated, and boundary-only records are excluded. A later database modification timestamp is not used to qualify an item.

searched_topics: agent and tool security, including MCP, plugins, browsers, delegated authority, and autonomous action
identity, authentication, authorization, credentials, and least privilege
model, dataset, dependency, artifact, runtime, cloud, hardware, and deployment supply chains
threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluation, assurance, monitoring, and release gates
AI security standards, regulation, governance, audit evidence, and risk management
public AI security incidents, mitigations, patches, disclosures, and lessons learned

wiki_and_routing_context.routing_rule: Keep the security finding, affected boundary, mitigation, and operating implication in this downstream wiki. Broad products and general AI-assisted-development practices remain upstream-owned.

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: NVD public CVE record with linked project release and public advisory
qualifying_findings.summary: Cognition before 0.13.0 exposes an unauthenticated REST/SSE session API while defaulting its agent sandbox backend to local execution. An attacker can create a session and direct the Deep Agents ReAct loop to run shell commands as the server process.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: Cognition before 0.13.0; REST/SSE session API and local-shell agent sandbox backend.
qualifying_findings.ai_security_relevance: The finding crosses an unauthenticated network boundary into autonomous agent tool execution and local command authority.

upstream_routing.note: Retain the authentication-to-tool-execution boundary and upgrade action locally; route general product coverage upstream.

qualifying_findings.follow_up: Verify the v0.13.0 release notes and any migration controls before durable synthesis.

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: NVD public CVE record with linked project remediation commits
qualifying_findings.summary: NoteGen through 0.38.3 accepts unvalidated synced sourceUrl paths in chat image analysis. A collaborator able to write to the sync target can provide an absolute or file URL, causing the application to read a local image and send it to the AI provider.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: NoteGen through 0.38.3; synced chat-image sourceUrl path passed to image_inspect.
qualifying_findings.ai_security_relevance: Untrusted collaborative content can exfiltrate local data across the application-to-model-provider privacy boundary.

upstream_routing.note: Keep the local-data-to-provider disclosure control locally; route general NoteGen product context upstream.

qualifying_findings.follow_up: Confirm the first fixed release and whether existing sync targets need remediation.

qualifying_findings.evidence_classification: NVD public CVE record with linked project commit
qualifying_findings.summary: Speaches through 0.9.0-rc.3 allows attacker-controlled model input to select classes or code in its Pyannote diarization model-loading path; NVD reports public exploit availability and no project response.
qualifying_findings.ai_security_relevance: Untrusted model selection crosses into executable runtime behavior, creating a model-artifact and inference supply-chain risk.

upstream_routing.note: Retain the model-loader execution boundary locally; route general product background upstream.

qualifying_findings.follow_up: Recheck project response, exploit conditions, and a fixed version before durable guidance.

qualifying_findings.summary: LangBot through 4.11.0 does not verify Lark/Feishu webhook signatures, allowing an unauthenticated actor knowing a bot UUID to forge message or card-action events that drive the LLM pipeline, tools, and approvals as another user.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: LangBot through 4.11.0; Lark/Feishu event ingress into LLM, tool, and approval flows.
qualifying_findings.ai_security_relevance: Forged identity events can acquire delegated authority over agent tools and approval workflows.

upstream_routing.note: Keep the event-authentication and delegated-authority implication locally; route ordinary chat-bot background upstream.

qualifying_findings.follow_up: Locate the maintainer advisory or patch and determine whether event replay protections are also required.

qualifying_findings.summary: SGLang through 0.5.22 accepts client-controlled bootstrap_host and bootstrap_port values in prefill/decode disaggregation mode. An unauthenticated caller can make the decode worker request internal hosts and ports and block the shared scheduler loop.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: SGLang through 0.5.22; Decode worker /generate endpoint in prefill/decode disaggregation mode.
qualifying_findings.ai_security_relevance: An inference-serving endpoint can become an internal-network and availability pivot through server-side request forgery.

upstream_routing.note: Retain the inference-network boundary and mitigation locally; route broad SGLang coverage upstream.

qualifying_findings.follow_up: Identify the fixed release and document network-egress containment as an interim control.

qualifying_findings.summary: crewai-tools through 1.15.28 does not apply its private-address validation in SeleniumScrapingTool. Prompt-influenced tool input can direct headless Chrome to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud-metadata addresses and disclose internal data or credentials.
qualifying_findings.affected_boundary_or_version: crewai-tools through 1.15.28; SeleniumScrapingTool URL handling; fixed version not confirmed by this run.
qualifying_findings.ai_security_relevance: Prompt injection can be converted into browser-tool SSRF against privileged internal and cloud credential surfaces.

upstream_routing.note: Retain the prompt-to-browser-tool SSRF security boundary locally; general CrewAI framework coverage is upstream-owned.

qualifying_findings.follow_up: Confirm patched release, URL-filter behavior, and any browser network-isolation guidance before durable synthesis.

upstream_routing_notes.entity_scope: Cognition, NoteGen, Speaches, LangBot, SGLang, and CrewAI product or framework background
upstream_routing_notes.local_retention: Only the vulnerability, affected boundary, mitigation, and operational security implication.

upstream_routing_notes.entity_scope: ordinary agent and development workflow practices
upstream_routing_notes.local_retention: Only the identity, tool-execution, privacy, SSRF, or supply-chain control that is a distinct security finding.

The pre-existing same-day raw artifact is untracked work not created or modified by this run; it is cited only as a de-duplication boundary.
